# payload-auth-link

> payload-auth-link: a hexagonal ports/adapters Payload CMS auth plugin. Identity providers (Better Auth, Auth.js) are swappable adapters behind IdentityProviderPort; users stay first-class Payload documents. First-class Next.js (Payload v3) and TanStack Start (Payload v4) adapters share one framework-free web core. ESM-only, strict TypeScript, Result-based errors. Example apps at examples/basic and examples/tanstack-start; 24 Playwright specs green per suite across SQLite, Postgres, and Mongo on both frameworks (SQLite suites in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit).

- [docs/PLAN-CAPABILITIES.md](./docs/PLAN-CAPABILITIES.md): Auth capabilities plan (MFA, passkeys, OAuth, magic link, orgs…) across both providers.

## Key source files

- [packages/core/src/ports.ts](./packages/core/src/ports.ts): Port interfaces: the hexagonal seams.
- [packages/plugin/src/options.ts](./packages/plugin/src/options.ts): Plugin options shape.
- [packages/plugin/src/session.ts](./packages/plugin/src/session.ts): Session bridge: providers to Payload users.
- [packages/provider-better-auth/src/engine.ts](./packages/provider-better-auth/src/engine.ts): Better Auth composition root.
- [packages/provider-authjs/src/engine.ts](./packages/provider-authjs/src/engine.ts): Auth.js composition root.
- [examples/basic/payload.config.ts](./examples/basic/payload.config.ts): Reference plugin wiring.
- [examples/basic/lib/auth.ts](./examples/basic/lib/auth.ts): Reference Better Auth engine.
- [examples/basic/lib/authjs.ts](./examples/basic/lib/authjs.ts): Reference Auth.js engine + credentials.
